Class NativeMacOsWindowControl

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.platform.NativeMacOsWindowControl
public class NativeMacOsWindowControl extends Object
macOS NSVisualEffectView integration through JNA and the Objective-C runtime (libobjc.dylib). Adds a vibrancy effect, or frosted-glass blur, behind JavaFX window content. On Apple Silicon (arm64), objc_msgSend with varargs cannot be used safely through JNA; com.sun.jna.Function.invoke() with fixed argument types is required. NSVisualEffectView sizing uses Auto Layout constraints instead of initWithFrame: because passing a CGRect struct through JNA on arm64 is problematic.

    • makeVisibleInAppSwitcher

      public void makeVisibleInAppSwitcher()
      Makes the window visible in Cmd+Tab (App Switcher). JavaFX StageStyle.TRANSPARENT creates an NSWindow with NSWindowStyleMaskBorderless (0). Add Titled + FullSizeContentView + Resizable for native appearance and resizing. RootPane custom resizing is disabled on macOS because resizing is handled natively.

    • applyVisualEffect

      public boolean applyVisualEffect(boolean darkMode)
      Approach: 1. Create NSVisualEffectView with init, using a zero frame. 2. Add it as a subview of contentView behind the JavaFX layer. 3. Use Auto Layout constraints so the view fills the whole contentView. This is more reliable than initWithFrame/autoresizingMask because it does not require passing a CGRect struct through JNA on arm64.
